title: O Love of God Most Full

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: O love of God most full,
O love of God most free,
Come warm my heart,come fill my soul,

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: So shines Thy love on me,
It wraps me 'round with kindly care,

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: The darkest night is full of light,

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: O love of God most full,
O love of God most free,
It warms my heart, it fills my soul,
